summary: C3is Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a one-for-40 reverse stock split of its common stock, effective August 18, 2026, reducing outstanding shares from approximately 57.6 million to 1.44 million. No fractional shares were issued; cash was paid in lieu. Warrants and Series A Convertible Preferred Stock were proportionally adjusted, with price adjustments based on volume-weighted average prices. The stock trades on Nasdaq under symbol CISS with a new CUSIP. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation.
